sections.section_title: FDCAN Tx buffer transmission interrupt enable register (FDCAN_TXBTIE)
sections.text_helper: Section 71.5.42 "FDCAN Tx buffer transmission interrupt enable register (FDCAN_TXBTIE)" in chapter 71 (Controller area network with flexible data rate (FDCAN)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 3714.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x00E0
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
Bits 31:0 TIE[31:0]: Transmission interrupt enable
Each Tx buffer has its own transmission interrupt enable bit.
0: Transmission interrupt disabled
1: Transmission interrupt enable
